{{Quote|What do you know about Chop'aa?''"<br />"''Chop'aa? He's scum.|Starkiller and Rahm Kota|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
'''Chop'aa Notimo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who fought for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the end of the conflict, he briefly joined the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate before striking out on his own. Notimo took over criminal operations in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]], including the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|colony]]. As an underworld kingpin, he employed a number of henchmen, including his second-in-command, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kleef]]. 

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Notimo [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|kidnapped]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] on Cloud City, but was confronted shortly afterward by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]'s [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], who was searching for the Senator. Notimo engaged Starkiller in battle using his personal [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]], but he was unable to defeat his opponent and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:Notimo_armor.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Notimo in full Mandalorian armor]]
Born during the twilight years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Chop'aa Notimo was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="TFU" /> [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who operated as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He did so because he believed that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="TFU databank" />&mdash;[[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the Mandalorian [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref>&mdash;were abominable corruptions of the Mandalorian legacy.<ref name="TFU databank" /> 

At some point in his life, Notimo lost his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and was left with prominent scars on his face.<ref name="TFU" /> He also acquired a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]], based on the design of the ancient war mount used by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] of the past. Eventually, he amassed a Mandalorian following, who assisted him in his criminal endeavours.<ref name="TFU Basilisk">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}, '''Basilisk War Droid''' entry</ref>

===Underworld kingpin===
After the Clone Wars ended, Notimo joined the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, quickly rising through its ranks. He eventually left Black Sun and began to operate on his own, however, proving himself a cunning underworld leader.<ref name="TFU databank" /> Notimo eventually took control of several criminal operations in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]], including those located in the underlevels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], an under-construction [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|colony]] floating over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TFU databank" /> 

Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Notimo also met the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Kleef]] and hired him to train the rest of Notimo's forces. Kleef eventually became Notimo's most trusted [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and second-in-command.<ref name="TFU Kleef">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}, '''Kleef''' entry</ref> 

===Cloud City brawl===
{{Quote|Your talks have failed, Senator. This is how ''I'' negotiate!|Chop'aa Notimo, to Garm Bel Iblis, while preparing to attack Starkiller|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:GalenVSNotimo.png|thumb|right|250px|Notimo battling Starkiller atop the Basilisk]]
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Notimo's forces assaulted Cloud City and engaged in battle against the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] led by<ref name="TFU" /> Cloud City's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] liaison officer,<ref name="TFU databank Lobot">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}, '''Lobot''' entry</ref> the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], who was present on the mining colony at the time of the attack, went to the loading bays to negotiate with Notimo regarding the cessation of hostilities. Notimo, however, dispatched bounty hunters to capture Bel Iblis; Kleef succeeded in the task and brought the Senator before him. Simultaneously, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|arrived on Cloud City]] in search of Bel Iblis in order to enlist his support in the organization of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|resistance]] against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TFU" />

Starkiller made his way through Cloud City, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Notimo's henchmen, including Kleef, and eventually reached the chamber where Notimo was holding Bel Iblis hostage. Already expecting his arrival, Notimo attacked Starkiller using his two-pronged [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]], backed by two of his Mandalorian guards equipped with [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice killed the two Mandalorians, and Notimo used a remote control built into his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] to call in his Basilisk. In the midst of the battle, Starkiller managed to jump aboard Notimo's mount, and the two [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. Finally, Starkiller used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|rip the Basilisk apart]], throwing it into a wall. Emerging from the burning rubble of the destroyed machine, Notimo attacked his foe on [[Limb/Legends|foot]], only to be fatally slashed across the chest by the aspiring Sith. Following Notimo's death, Bel Iblis joined Starkiller's cause, and they left Cloud City to [[Corellian Treaty|rendezvous]] with other rebel leaders&mdash;[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]&mdash;on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TFU" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|An immoral criminal who has taken over underworld operations in this sector.|Rahm Kota, on Notimo|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:Chopaa.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chop'aa Notimo, unmasked]]
A cunning underworld kingpin<ref name="TFU databank" /> who was described succinctly as immoral "scum" by Starkiller's companion, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]],<ref name="TFU" /> Chop'aa Notimo took pride in his Mandalorian heritage. He was disgusted by the Republic's clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], considering them a disgrace to the Mandalorian culture. This hatred was what led him to fight for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Notimo was a professional criminal who quickly gained prominence in the Black Sun organization.<ref name="TFU databank" /> After recruiting Kleef, Notimo came to trust the Gungan completely.<ref name="TFU Kleef" /> Later, Notimo was determined to keep Bel Iblis as his prize, and Kota believed that there was no diplomatic way to convince him to let the Senator go.<ref name="TFU" />

Notimo had [[Color/Legends|black]] facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown eyes&mdash;one of which was missing&mdash;and light skin.<ref name="TFU" /> Despite lacking one eye, Notimo was a vicious and capable combatant,<ref name="TFU databank" /> although he did not always fight fairly.<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> He wielded his electrostaff with great efficiency and was able to slam it into the ground and create shockwaves that knocked down his opponents off of their feet. Notimo was confident in his abilities, constantly taunting Starkiller during their duel and stating that he would kill him.<ref name="TFU" />

In addition to his staff, Notimo made use of his personal Basilisk war droid, armed with three powerful [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]] and low-[[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] that allowed it to hover during combat. The Basilisk possessed a rudimentary [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] and was capable of operating in almost any environment, even in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TFU Basilisk" /> Notimo's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] had a built-in remote control for the droid.<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chop up Chop'aa!|''The Force Unleashed'' walkthrough for the Wii version|<ref name="Guide" />}}
Chop'aa Notimo was created by [[Krome Studios]] for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Nintendo Wii]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']]. In the game, he was portrayed by [[Billy Brown]]. Notimo can be unlocked as a playable character skin during gameplay via the NOTIMO cheat code. When he is selected for use, however, cutscenes are disabled.<ref name="TFU" />
